key.name: backend
key.description: Server type of the current session. "none" means logged out.

key.name: username
key.description: The account name used to authenticate with the server

key.name: url
key.description: Base URL of the music server, including the scheme

key.name: user-id
key.description: Server-side user ID (Jellyfin). Empty for OpenSubsonic.

key.name: device-id
key.description: Stable client device ID sent to Jellyfin. Generated on first use and kept across logouts.

key.name: last-sync
key.description: Timestamp of the last time that metadata was queried from the server

key.name: gapless-playback
key.description: Whether songs follow each other without a pause. When off, each song ends before the next one is loaded.

key.name: replay-gain-enabled
key.description: Whether the volume of each song is adjusted using the ReplayGain tags in the audio file. Applies from the next song that is loaded.

key.name: replay-gain-mode
key.description: "track" levels every song to the same loudness; "album" keeps the loudness differences within an album and falls back to the track gain when a song has no album gain.

key.name: transcode-profile-unmetered
key.description: "original" plays the original files; the others ask the server to re-encode songs above 320, 192 or 96 kbit/s. Applies from the next song that is loaded.

key.name: transcode-profile-metered
key.description: Same choices as on unmetered connections, used while the system reports the connection as metered.

key.name: transcode-format
key.description: The codec the server encodes to when it transcodes. "auto" uses Opus on Jellyfin and MP3 on OpenSubsonic servers.

key.name: transcode-unsupported
key.description: Whether songs in a format this device can't decode are transcoded by the server. When off, such songs are skipped.
